target: 578 Marionettae

source: 578 Marionettes
target: 578 Marionettae

source: Amidst the thunderous explosion, the partition separating the two suites and the one facing the corridor crumbled simultaneously, wreaking havoc on nearby furniture, the ceiling above, the floor beneath their feet, and the rooms opposite, swiftly enveloping them in a surging inferno.
target: In medio tonitruosae explosionis, divisio quae duas cubicula et illud, quod ad corridorium spectabat, separabat, simul corruit, vastitatem intulit supellectili proxima, laqueari superiore, pavimento inferiore sub pedibus, et conclavi opposita, eos celeriter in ferventem incendium involvens.

source: Jenna hadn’t utilized all the explosives; otherwise, the entire fifth and fourth floors of Solow Motel would have collapsed in unison.
target: Jenna non omnia explosiva adhibuerat; alioquin toti tabulati quintus et quartus Solow Motel simul corruissent.

source: Nevertheless, a section of the roof gave way, and the floor was strewn in chaos.
target: Tamen, pars tecti cecidit, et pavimentum in confusione dispersi erat.

source: The epicenter of the blast unveiled the room below.
target: Epicentrum explosionis patefecit conclave inferius.

source: As the walls of the adjacent rooms succumbed to the onslaught, the bricks and wood propelled by the shockwave slammed into Giorgia, causing her back to buckle, and her head to split open, unleashing a flow of vivid red blood.
target: Dum parietes conclavium adjacentium impetu cedebant, lateres et ligna, quae ictu impetuoso allata erant, in Giorgiam irruerunt, facientes ut tergo eius deflexum fieret et caput eius discidum, effundentes flumen sanguinis rubri.

source: Lugano snapped out of his intermittent thoughts and bodily stiffness, regaining his composure.
target: Lugano e cogitationibus intermissis et corpore rigido se evexit, suam tranquillitatem restituens.

source: Subsequently, he experienced searing pain as the violent shockwave, mixed with flames and debris, hurled him through the air.
target: Subinde, acutum dolorem sensit, dum violenta unda ictus, cum flammis et dispersis rebus mixta, eum per aerem iactavit.

source: Had it not been for Giorgia shielding him and with his robust Planter’s physique, he likely would have faced severe injuries, teetering on the brink of death.
target: Nisi propter Giorgiam, quae eum protegebat, et robustam habitum Planteris, probabiliter graves laesiones passurus fuisset, in limine mortis labens.

source: Limbs could have been severed, or vital points struck.
target: Membra seccari potuissent, aut puncta vitalia feriri.

source: Despite this, he ended up a battered mess, with a few bones broken, nearly succumbing to unconsciousness.
target: Attamen, ipse vulneratus evasit, cum paucis ossibus fractis, paene in inconscientiam lapsus.

source: Ludwig had sought refuge under the dining table at some point—along with his food.
target: Ludwig quaesiverat refugium sub mensa cenae, simul cum cibo suo.

source: With the advantage of distance and the makeshift “shield,” he only bore the impact of the collapsed table.
target: Propter distantiam et improvisum scutum, solum ictum mensae corruperae tulit.

source: Simultaneously, Jenna and Anthony burst out of the master bedroom washroom in their suite, their gazes fixed on the adjacent rooms where walls had crumbled, filling the air with swirling dust.
target: Simul, Jenna et Anthony ex balneo cubiculi principali in sua suite effugerunt, oculis in conclavia adiacentia fixa, ubi parietes corruperant, aerem cum circumvoluto pulvere implebant.

source: They vaguely discerned a figure.
target: Vagiter deprehenderunt quandam figuram.

source: The figure, bearing a striking resemblance to Rubió Paco, stood beside the upturned recliner.
target: Figura, quae Rubió Paco insigniter similis erat, iuxta lectum revolutum stetit.

source: Loki! Jenna wasted no time.
target: Loki! Jenna sine mora egit.

source: She condensed a dark, illusory flame and sent it hurtling towards her target.
target: Flammam obscuram et illusoriariam condensavit, eam versus metam celeriter iactans.

source: Behind her, Anthony Reid’s eyes took on a golden tint, pupils dilating.
target: Post eam, oculi Anthony Reid auro tincti sunt, pupillae dilatatae.

source: He was poised to lock onto Loki, ready to unleash Frenzy—a technique that would plunge Loki into an emotionally and psychologically triggered state, rendering him incapable of rational thought and effective response.
target: Paratus erat ad incidendum in Lokim, Frenzy emittendi, technica enim quae Lokim in statum affectuum et psychologicum perturbatum immergere posset, eo ut rationem cogitandi ac responsionem efficacem amitteret.

source: Just as Anthony and Jenna prepared to strike, their vision darkened, and Loki vanished.
target: Ita ut Anthony et Jenna ad feriendum parati essent, visio eorum obscurata est, et Loki evanuit.

source: They found themselves in a void, no blue sky or white clouds above, no solid ground below—just darkness embellished with a myriad of stars.
target: Eos invenit vacuum, ubi nec caelum caeruleum nec nubila alba supra, nec terra firma infra erat, sed tantum tenebrae cum innumeris stellis ornatae erant.

source: Cosmic Void!
target: Vacuum Cosmicum!

source: This semi‐real, semi‐false illusion was a creation achievable by a Child of the Sea at a certain level.
target: Haec semi‐realis, semi‐falsa illusio erat creatio a Puer Maris ad certum gradum perficiendum.

source: In the void, Jenna and Anthony beheld a widowed woman in a black bonnet with subtle wrinkles in front of them.
target: In vacuo, Jenna et Anthony conspexerunt feminam viduam, cum cuculla nigra et subtilibus rugis, coram eis.

source: Martha!
target: Martha!

source: The Paco family’s matriarch, now a marionette under Loki’s control, was hidden in the room where Loki manipulated the Spirit Body Threads.
target: Matriarcha familiae Paco, nunc marionetta sub potestate Loki, erat abscondita in conclavi ubi Loki Fila Spiritus Corporis manipulat.

source: With sufficient preparation time, how could Loki not perform with his marionettes?
target: Cum tempore sufficiente praeparatorio, quomodo Loki non cum suis marionettis agere posset?

source: He had two puppets with Beyonder powers, and this was one of them.
target: Duas marionettae habebat cum potentia Beyonder, et haec una ex illis erat.

source: Another remained concealed, with the last slot reserved for specific situations, adaptable at will.
target: Altera manebat celata, cum ultima pars ad certas res reservata esset, quae ad voluntatem adaptari posset.

source: It could be switched once an enemy was under control.
target: Potuit commutari, cum hostis sub potestate esset.

source: When Loki posed as Rubió Paco, bringing Madam Martha to meet the Governor of the Sea, the family’s matriarch was already a marionette.
target: Cum Loki se comparabat Rubió Paco, et Domina Martha ad conveniendum Praefectum Maris adducebat, matriarcha familiae iam marionetta erat.

source: Thus, he had to ensure she stayed within his control range.
target: Ergo, oportuit ut ea intra ambitum sui imperii remaneretur.

source: Lugano discerned Madam Martha’s severe injuries primarily because a marionette was essentially comparable to a lifeless entity.
target: Lugano graves laesiones Dominae Martha praecipue animadvertit, quoniam marionetta ad entitatem sine vita similis erat.

source: A Marionettist’s manipulation of her Spirit Body Threads allowed her to execute various actions, mimicking living characteristics.
target: Per manipulationem Filarum Spiritus Corporis a Marionettista, illa varias actiones perficere potuit, vivarum qualitatum similitudinem imitans.

source: To a Sequence 8 Doctor, this appeared as grave injuries.
target: Ad Medicum Sequentionis VIII, haec videbantur ut laesiones graves.

source: Had Lumian not infrequently observed others’ luck without forming a habit, he would have realized that Madam Martha’s fate was off.
target: Si Lumian non saepiose aliorum fortunam spectaverat, sine consuetudine formata, intellexisset fatum Dominae Martha non esse rectum.

source: It was eerily still, resembling death.
target: Mirabiliter quietum erat, morti simile.

source: Martha, a subtle smile on her face, lifted her right hand, a spectral green light coalescing at her fingertips.
target: Martha, subtile subrisu in facie, dextram manum levavit, ubi lumen viride spectrum ad digitos eius coalescebat.

source: The radiance morphed into a beam that streaked towards Jenna.
target: Splendor in trabem mutatus est, quae versus Jenna traiecit.

source: Having heard Lumian explain the sea bloodline’s abilities, Jenna, at the sight of the spectral green light, rolled out of the Cosmic Void.
target: Audito Lumiano de facultatibus sanguinis maris, Jenna, lumen viride spectrum conspecto, ex Vacuum Cosmicum evoluta est.

source: Anthony followed suit.
target: Anthony idem secutus est.

source: He refrained from using Frenzy on Martha since a marionette, essentially dead, wouldn’t succumb to frenzy.
target: Ab Anthony Frenzy in Martha non adhibitus est, quia marionetta, quasi mortua, ad frenzia succumbere non posset.

source: In the next moment, they both felt a weightiness, plummeting swiftly through the empty cosmos.
target: In momento sequenti, uterque gravitatem sensit, celeriter per vacuum cosmo labens.

source: They experienced the weightlessness Franca occasionally mentioned.
target: Experti sunt defectum gravitatis, quem Franca aliquando commemoravit.

source: In the blink of an eye, Jenna and Anthony landed on the ground and steadied themselves, yet Martha was nowhere to be seen.
target: In ictu oculi, Jenna et Anthony super terram ceciderunt et se firmaverunt, sed Martha nusquam visa erat.

source: The empty cosmos was shattering inch by inch.
target: Vacuum cosmos, passu passu, frangebatur.

source: They were still in Solow Motel, but they had descended from the fifth floor to the fourth.
target: Adsunt in Solow Motel adhuc, sed a quinto tabulato ad quartum descenderant.

source: This was because the mid- to low-level Cosmic Void resembled more of an illusion.
target: Hoc erat, nam Vacuum Cosmicum mediis et inferioribus gradibus illusio pluris videbatur.

source: There would be a barrier akin to a wall of spirituality around them.
target: Circa eos obstaculum, simile muro spiritualitatis, exstitisset.

source: After falling into it, their bodies remained in reality.
target: Postquam in id ceciderunt, corpora eorum in re manserunt.

source: As they rolled and dodged, Martha nudged them forcefully with her formless power, causing them to plunge into the floor cavity created by the explosives.
target: Dum volvebant et evitabant, Martha eos cum potentia sua informe vehementer impellit, faciens ut in cavitatem pavimenti, quam explosiva creaverant, caderent.

source: Jenna didn’t hesitate.
target: Jenna non dubitavit.

source: She sprinted up the wall, seized a crack, and flipped back to the fifth floor where the explosion had occurred.
target: Jenna murum celeriter ascendit, fissuram arripuit, et se in quintum tabulatum volvens reddidit, ubi explosio facta erat.

source: She saw Lugano tending to his injuries, and Loki and Madam Martha were absent from the room diagonally opposite.
target: Vidit Lugano vulnera sua curare, et Loki et Domina Martha in conclavi diagonaliter opposito abesse.

source: Ludwig, who had hidden under the dining table, had vanished as well!
target: Ludwig, qui sub mensa cenae se absconderat, etiam evanuerat!

source: On Aquina Street, amid a lively folk celebration, Loki, having transformed into an inconspicuous passerby, carried Ludwig, who had “fallen asleep,” through the crowd.
target: In via Aquina, inter festum popularis laetitiae, Loki, qui se in transeuntum ignotum converterat, Ludwig, qui obdormiverat, per turbam portavit.

source: His other marionette, a Soul Assurer of the Evernight pathway, stayed concealed on the opposite side of Lumian’s suite, ready to exert influence on the target.
target: Altera marionetta eius, «Animam Assecuratrix» per semitam Evernight appellata, in parte opposita suite Lumiani celata mansit, praeparata ad obiectum influendum.

source: Initially, Loki had dispatched his temporary marionette, Giorgia, to handle Lugano.
target: Initio, Loki marionettam temporariam suam, Giorgiam, ad Lugano operandum misit.

source: He had manipulated the Doctor’s Spirit Body Threads but refrained from deploying his more potent marionettes.
target: Filiis Spiritus Corporis Medici manipulaverat, sed a marionettis potentioribus adhibendis abstinuit.

source: It wasn’t due to fear of alerting Ludwig, but rather a concern that an unseen adversary might be lurking in the shadows.
target: Non timore Ludwig excitandi, sed de cura, ne hostis invisus in umbris lateret, fuit.

source: After all, several lodgers in the motel hadn’t left for the sea prayer ritual celebrations.
target: Nam multi hospites in motel nondum profecti sunt ad celebrandas ritus orationis maris.

source: A couple had returned before lunchtime next door, almost synchronizing with the target.
target: Par duo ante prandium ad domum vicinam redierant, paene synchroni cum scopo.

source: Moreover, a Marionettist’s advancement ritual demanded a grand performance—a splendid and profound drama.
target: Praeterea, ritus progressionis Marionettistae magnum spectaculum exigit—drama splendidum et profundum.

source: Silent, unnoticed assassinations lacking a sufficient audience failed to meet the requirements.
target: Assassinationes silentiae et imperceptae, quae sufficiens audientia caret, requisita non implebant.

source: Therefore, Loki intentionally singled out Lugano first.
target: Ergo, Loki primum Lugano intentione singulariter designavit.

source: If there were no other foes lurking, it was akin to switching marionettes.
target: Si nulli alii hostes latentes essent, erat sicut marionettae commutatio.

source: If there were, he could draw them all to him and clandestinely manipulate the target with the other marionette nearby.
target: Si vero alii essent, eos omnes ad se allicere poterat et, clandestine, cum altera marionetta proxima, obiectum manipulare.

source: Aware that it was a sealed demigod, Loki knew its strength might be limited, but its essence remained unchanged.
target: Conscius quod deum semi‑divinus clausus esset, Loki scivit vires eius limitatas esse, sed essentia eius immutata manere.

source: It was impervious to many influences.
target: Ad multas influentiis impervius erat.

source: However, he believed the Evernight pathway’s forced sleep would still be effective.
target: Attamen, credidit somnum coactum per semitam Evernight adhuc efficacem fore.

source: Since this sealed demigod could experience exhaustion, hunger, and the need for rest, food, and sleep like a true child, it implied that the seal had impacted corresponding characteristics, making him akin to an ordinary person in those aspects.
target: Quoniam hic deum semi‑divinus clausus lassitudinem, famem, atque necessitatem quietis, cibi, et somni, ut puer verus, experiri posset, id implicabat sigillum proprietates congruentes affecisse, eum in hisce ad hominem ordinarum similem reddens.

source: At most, he would awaken faster and require less rest time.
target: Maxime, celerius evigilaret atque tempus quietis brevius opus haberet.

source: A few seconds would be ample time for Loki to relocate and conceal himself with the target before attempting to manipulate the other party’s Spirit Body Threads.
target: Nonnulli secundi sufficiebant ut Loki locum mutaret et se cum obiectivo celaret, antequam alterorum Fila Spiritus Corporis manipularet.

source: His two marionettes would act independently, confusing both enemies and the Earth Mother Church clergyman rushing over.
target: Duae marionettae eius agere independentiter consueverant, confundentes hostes atque clergonem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae qui properabat.

source: They would lead them on a chase spanning about 100 to 200 meters, completing the corresponding performance.
target: Illos in insequentem ducere poterant, per spatium circiter a centum ad ducentos metra, spectaculum idoneum perfaciendo.

source: As the time approached, the enemies would pinpoint his hiding spot through the marionettes’ trajectory, joyfully anticipating an encounter.
target: Cum tempus appropinquaret, hostes locum eius absconditum per cursum marionettarum determinare poterant, congressum exspectantes cum laetitia.

source: However, what awaited them would be a demigod-level marionette, leading to a terrifying and grim outcome.
target: Attamen, quod eis obveniret, marionetta gradus semi‑divinus esset, quae ad exitum terribilem et tristissimum duceret.

source: Under the watchful eyes of the surrounding citizens, the magnificent play would conclude.
target: Sub oculis vigilantibus civium circumstantium, pulcherrimum spectaculum concludebatur.

source: Loki could consume the potion and ascend to Sequence 4, becoming a Bizarro Sorcerer!
target: Loki potionem consumere potuit et ad Sequentionem IV ascendere, atque Bizarro Magus fieri!

source: On the betrothal ship, within Lato Guiaro’s Cosmic Void.
target: In nave sponsali, intra Vacuum Cosmicum Lato Guiaro.

source: This was fundamentally different from lower-middle-level abilities.
target: Hoc fundamentaliter diversum erat ab facultatibus gradus inferiore‑mediis.

source: It was both an illusory realm and an alternate space that could cause people to lose themselves and become abnormally fragile.
target: Erat et regnum illusorium et spatium alternum, quod homines se ipsos perdere et insolite fragiles fieri faceret.

source: It was akin to the Bottle of Fiction augmented with hallucinations.
target: Erat quasi phiala fabularum, hallucinationibus aucta.

source: The sticky blob of flesh Lumian had expelled squirmed rapidly, stretching and expanding into a discernible figure.
target: Globulus carnis viscosae, quem Lumian expulit, celeriter contorquens, extendens et expandendo in figuram discernibilem conversus est.

source: Cloaked in blood-red fabric with a matching hood obscuring its face in shadows, the figure revealed itself as none other than Mr. K of the Aurora Order.
target: Indutus in panno rubro sanguine, cum galea congrua faciem umbris tegente, figura se revelavit ut nihil aliud quam Dominus K Ordinis Aurorae.

source: To counter April Fool’s machinations, Lumian had chosen the strategy of overwhelming force.
target: Ut machinamenta April Fool’s oppelleret, Lumian consilium vires opprimentis uti statuit.

source: He accomplished this with overt and imposing power, complemented by meticulous arrangements.
target: Id efficivit per vim apertam et imponentem, complementatam dispositionibus diligenter constitutis.

source: This plan allowed for a fair margin of error.
target: Hoc consilium aequam spatium erroris concessit.

source: Even if Lumian made a miscalculation, as long as April Fool’s didn’t have Angel-level helpers or three or more Saints, he could salvage the situation by retaining at least one or two key members.
target: Etiamsi Lumian errorem fecisset, dummodo April Fool’s non haberet adiutores angelorum gradus nec tria aut plura Sanctos, poterat rem salvari retinendo saltem unum vel duo membrum praecipuum.

source: To enhance their odds, Franca extended invitations to Hela and Gandalf.
target: Ad meliores casus obtinendos, Franca invitationes ad Hela et Gandalf misit.

source: The Fertility Order also notified the higher-ups, ensuring the presence of a Saint overseeing Port Santa during the sea prayer ritual.
target: Ordo Fertilitatis superiores numinavit, ut Sanctus Portus Santae, tempore ritus orationis maris, adsit.

source: The Tarot Club had two Major Arcana card holders positioned nearby.
target: Club Tarot duos titulares chartarum Arcanae Maioris prope constitutos habebat.

source: When April Fool’s key members felt secure, Madam Magician, the Angel of Stars, would cross a long distance and descend as they prepared to depart!
target: Quando membra principales April Fool’s securum sensissent statum, Domina Magician, Angelus Stellarum, longum iter transiret atque descenderet, in praeparatione discedendi!

source: For extra precaution, Lumian utilized Mr. K’s finger to get him to Port Santa.
target: Ad cautelam additicam, Lumian digitum Domini K adhibuit, quo eum ad Portum Santa deduceret.

source: Morphing with the Rose Bishop’s power, he turned into a fleshy blob, and was concealed in Lumian’s stomach to infiltrate the betrothal ship.
target: Mutans virtute Episcopi Rosae, se in globum carnosum mutavit, et in stomacho Lumiani celatus est, ut nave sponsali inpenetraret.

source: Mr. K glanced up, his eyes taking on an otherworldly illusion, as if concealing hidden doors.
target: Dominus K sursum respexit, et oculi eius aliam illusionem praebuerunt, quasi portas absconditas celarent.

source: Swiftly scanning the Cosmic Void, he identified an escape route.
target: Celeriter Vacuum Cosmicum perspexit, et viam effugiendi deprehendit.

source: “Follow me,” he said to Lumian in a hoarse voice.
target: “Sequere me,” rauco voce ad Lumian dixit.

source: Nodding, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag, extracting the Flog boxing gloves and preparing to don them.
target: Nodante, Lumian in Saccum Viatoris pervenit, chirothecas pugilatorias Flog extraxit et induere paratus est.

source: If you guys still have a backup plan or if a few powerhouses don’t appear in time, I’ll draw the attention of the evil gods and create chaos.
target: Si vos adhuc consilium subsidiarium habetis aut si paucae potentiae non in tempore appareant, attentionem deorum malorum alliciam et chaos creabo.

source: We’ll all face the danger together. Early exits? Forget about it!
target: Nos omnes periculum simul subiemus. Exitus ante tempus? Obliviscamini!
